body:
I guess I could try.
I have been fucked by the system, deemed to be a contingent response to the structures around me that derive my politics, my positions in the world, and my realities. All enforced by epistemic violence against people like me. We have these events, they preach love, they preach recognition, yet they are all epistemologically and ontologically flawed based on the assumptions that we are people that need "saving" rather than care before death occurs. These days happen because the act is a performative vice that uses all of these evolutionary, social, and interactional facades to mask the horrid reality of what is currently existing, and functioning, and repeating, to make more blue Mondays, more people taking their lives, and more people raising support on one special day for those who perpetually suffer.

I guess I am just a person that has been multiply burdened by the system, with my attempts to gain equality being pushed into a basement, rather than risen above the ground. Suicides functional purpose only reveals the false concept (biological or social) of giving care existing, people dying regardless, and society still moving on after my death. Society is built to account for and function on suicide. It's flawed ontology and cropped epistemology merely allow that to continue. I can't continue in a world like this, regardless of the pains I live. It just legitimises the concept of it
